description: Identifies dead design tokens by scanning the project files. Checks each CSS custom property defined in @theme blocks to see if it is referenced anywhere in the source code.

css_path.description: Absolute path to the CSS file containing the @theme blocks

project_root.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

scan_dirs.description: Optional array of subdirectories to scan (defaults to ["src"])

name: audit_theme_usage
